name: application-split-pane-diff
title: Split Pane Diff
description: Side-by-side scroll-synced two-column layout for comparing document versions, driven by a typed left/right paragraph prop contract.
useWhen: Comparing two versions of prose content (legal terms, policies, documentation) rather than code.
Users benefit from reading full paragraphs side by side with additions and removals highlighted inline.
You want a reusable two-pane layout frame and can supply your own scroll-sync logic.
avoidWhen: You need line-by-line code diffing with line numbers — use the existing Diff component instead, which is built for that.
The comparison fits in a single column with inline strikethrough — a simpler unified view may be clearer.
Content is primarily images — use a Comparison Slider (drag reveal) instead of a text-oriented split pane.
responsiveBehavior: The two-column grid assumes enough width for both panes to remain readable; stack panes vertically on narrow viewports instead of shrinking columns further.
accessibility: Added and removed paragraphs use both a background tint and text color, with removed text also struck through, so the change type isn't conveyed by color alone.
The legend in the footer labels the removed/added color swatches with text, not color alone.
Version badges are paired with the file name so each pane's context remains clear independent of column position.

variants.title: Split Pane Diff
variants.description: Two-column document comparison with version badges, per-paragraph added/removed highlighting, and a synced-scroll footer legend.
accessibility: Removed text combines strikethrough styling with red color so it reads as removed even without color.

variants.title: Split Pane Diff (Dark)
variants.description: Split-pane document comparison adapted for dark surfaces with the same version-badge, paragraph-highlight, and legend structure.
accessibility: Added/removed paragraph tints and legend swatches must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
